title: .mcu-profile.json
description: Per-workspace MCU profile read by /opt/embedded/run-profile-task.sh (aliased as `mcu`). Keys split into metadata (scalars, exported to the environment by `mcu --export`) and tasks (command strings, executed by `mcu <key>`).

chip.description: Canonical part number, e.g. STM32WBA65RI, STM32F407VG, CH32V003F4P6. Drives probe-rs --chip, SVD lookup and size budgets.

core.description: Compiler core name passed as -mcpu / -march, e.g. cortex-m33, cortex-m0plus, rv32ec.

fpu.description: Value for -mfpu, or "none" for soft-float cores.

probe.description: Physical debug probe in use. Selects the OpenOCD interface config and informs probe-troubleshoot.

flashTool.description: Which tool the flash/erase/reset/debugServer tasks drive. Use probe-rs for any part OpenOCD 0.12 does not know (all STM32WBA6x, for example).

OPENOCD_INTERFACE.description: OpenOCD interface config, e.g. interface/stlink.cfg. Only used when flashTool is openocd.

OPENOCD_TARGET.description: OpenOCD target config, e.g. target/stm32f4x.cfg. Only used when flashTool is openocd.

SVD_FILE.description: Path to the target's CMSIS-SVD file. Leave empty and run `svd-find <chip>` to locate one in /opt/svd.

BMP_PORT.description: Black Magic Probe GDB serial port, e.g. /dev/ttyACM0.

PORT.description: Serial console device for the `serial` task.

BAUD.description: Serial console baud rate. Defaults to 115200.

ELF.description: Path to the built ELF. Defaults to build/firmware.elf.

rttChannel.description: SEGGER RTT up-channel to attach to for the `rtt` task.

sizeBudget.description: Hard limits enforced by the `size` task. It exits non-zero when the firmware exceeds them — the guardrail that stops binary size creeping up unnoticed during unattended development.

testTimeout.description: Seconds the `test` task captures target output before giving up.

testPass.description: Regex that must appear in captured target output for the `test` task to pass.

testFail.description: Regex that, if seen, fails the `test` task immediately.

debugServer.description: Start a GDB server on :3333. Must be a foreground process.

rtt.description: Attach to RTT and stream target output to stdout.

size.description: Report section sizes. Overrides the built-in budget-checking implementation.

test.description: Hardware-in-the-loop test: flash, run, capture, assert.

hostTest.description: Native x86 unit tests — no hardware required.

postBuild.description: Extra profile keys to run after a successful `build`, e.g. ["size", "hex"].
